```{r setup-mascot_anchors, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

```{r mascot_anchors-try-live, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_try_live("mascot_anchors")
```

```{r mascot_anchors-heading, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
guide_heading(paste0(mascot::mascot_character(studio_character)$name, "'s anchors"), "Anchors")
```

```{r mascot_anchors-table, echo = FALSE}
guide_each_character(function(ch) {
  anchors <- mascot::mascot_anchors(ch)
  if (nrow(anchors)) {
    guide_table(anchors)
  } else {
    htmltools::tags$p(paste(mascot::mascot_character(ch)$name, "has no anchors"))
  }
})
```

```{r mascot_anchors-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("mascot_anchors", studio_character)
```
